content.user_title: Run Parallel Research with Ten Agents
content.value_statement: Linear research can miss perspectives and take too long on broad questions. This skill directs users to a ten-agent workflow for parallel collection and synthesis.
actual_capabilities: Introduces a ten-agent approach for parallel research.
Identifies broad, extensive research as the intended task type.
Encourages gathering multiple perspectives before synthesis.
Links to the source repository for full installation and usage details.
Provides a manual command for cloning the external repository.
limitations: The package contains an overview, not the complete orchestration workflow.
Installation and detailed usage depend on a mutable external repository.
Parallel research may produce conflicting or duplicated findings.
Research outputs still require source verification and expert review.

use_cases.title: Build a literature overview
use_cases.description: Divide a broad topic into parallel evidence tracks, then combine agreements, disagreements, and open questions.

use_cases.title: Compare market options
use_cases.description: Research competitors, customers, pricing, regulations, and risks concurrently before preparing a strategic comparison.

use_cases.title: Prepare a decision brief
use_cases.description: Collect technical, financial, operational, and stakeholder evidence in parallel for a time-sensitive decision.

prompt_templates.title: Research a topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Infinite Gratitude to research [topic]. Summarize the main findings and list the supporting sources.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two options
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [option A] and [option B] in parallel. Compare evidence, tradeoffs, uncertainties, and source quality.

prompt_templates.title: Map an evidence landscape
prompt_templates.prompt: Assign parallel tracks for [topic]: history, current evidence, stakeholders, risks, alternatives, and open questions. Synthesize agreements and conflicts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a decision dossier
prompt_templates.prompt: Run ten parallel research tracks on [decision]. Define distinct scopes, require citations, reconcile contradictions, and produce recommendations with confidence levels.

output_examples.input: Research whether a regional retailer should adopt electric delivery vehicles.
output: Executive summary: Adoption is strongest for predictable urban routes with reliable depot charging.
Evidence themes: Vehicle cost, incentives, range, maintenance, grid capacity, and resale value drive the decision.
Uncertainty: Local charging timelines and future electricity prices require regional validation.

output_examples.input: Compare two knowledge management platforms for a distributed engineering team.
output_examples.output: The synthesis compares search quality, integrations, permissions, migration effort, total cost, and user feedback. It highlights conflicting evidence and unresolved questions.

best_practices: Define distinct research tracks before starting parallel work.
Require citations and publication dates for important claims.
Reconcile contradictions and state uncertainty in the final synthesis.
anti_patterns: Do not use ten agents for a narrow fact lookup.
Do not merge duplicate claims without checking their original sources.
Do not present agent consensus as proof of factual accuracy.

faq.question: What type of work suits this skill?
faq.answer: It suits broad research questions that benefit from several independent evidence tracks and a final synthesis.

faq.question: Does this package include the complete workflow?
faq.answer: No. The package provides an overview and directs users to an external repository for complete instructions.

faq.question: How many agents does the approach use?
faq.answer: The description specifies ten agents for parallel research execution.

faq.question: Does it verify every source automatically?
faq.answer: No. Users should inspect primary sources, publication dates, methods, and conflicting claims.

faq.question: Can it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. Domain experts should review high-impact conclusions, assumptions, and recommendations.

faq.question: Does installation require network access?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented clone command downloads a separate GitHub repository over the network.
